method: Each definition in s7-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its named test run alone (vitest -t), every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the test rerun. Integration tests run on local PostgreSQL with the real schema built from the migrations, so a mutation of a migration file reaches the disposable database; merchant and operator accounts are created by the operator functions with passwords generated in memory per run. PayPal is the labeled FIXTURE fake and OpenAI is never called; merchant shops are taken through the real merchant routes and the operator functions. A proof also needs the mutated run to fail on an AssertionError.
